headline: Loss narrows sharply as pricing and volumes rebound
summary_short: Huntsman's Q2 2026 revenue rose 14.1% y/y to $1,663M and adjusted EBITDA jumped 62.2% to $120M on higher pricing and volumes across all three segments, narrowing the net loss to $6M (-$0.03/share) from $158M a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue rose 14.1% y/y to $1,663M on higher prices and volumes across all three segments; MDI pricing improved across all regions on tighter supply-demand. Gross profit rose 34.6% to $245M and adjusted EBITDA rose 62.2% to $120M, aided by a $115M y/y drop in restructuring costs and a $22M gain on the Gomet divestiture, partly offset by higher SG&A from FX and incentive-comp accruals. Net loss attributable to Huntsman narrowed to $6M ($0.03/share) from $158M a year ago. Cash fell to $346M from $429M at year-end; H1 operating cash flow and free cash flow were both negative ($113M and $181M). No revenue or EPS guidance was issued; the proposed all-stock Olin merger remains pending.

drivers.explanation: Higher average selling prices and sales volumes across all three segments; MDI prices rose in all regions on tighter supply-demand, and MDI volumes grew in the Americas and Europe.
Higher gross profits in all three segments, tracking the revenue gains from pricing and volume.
Restructuring costs fell $115M y/y and a $22M gain on the Gomet business sale, partly offset by higher SG&A from FX moves and a higher incentive-compensation accrual.

Higher average selling prices, higher sales volumes, higher equity earnings from the China PO/MTBE joint venture, and cost-optimization savings, partly offset by higher raw-materials costs in Polyurethanes.
Tracks the swing to operating income plus the Gomet gain, partly offset by higher income tax expense from lower discrete tax benefits versus a year ago.

Results improved broadly on pricing/volume gains and lower restructuring costs across all segments; the company remains in a pending all-stock merger of equals with Olin (expected to close H1 2027), which restricts buybacks and financing activity meanwhile.
